name: upiqal
description: Cross-platform desktop app wrapping the FR-IQA (UPIQAL) image-quality algorithm.

scripts.build:sidecar: bash -c 'if [ -x engine/.venv/bin/python ]; then engine/.venv/bin/python engine/scripts/build_sidecar.py; else python3 engine/scripts/build_sidecar.py; fi'
scripts.build:release: npm run build:sidecar && npm run tauri:build
